scientific_integrity: The all-parameter statement is established analytically by a positive Volterra-convolution representation; finite tests are corroboration only. Residual publication-priority uncertainty remains; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns two-patch linear Floquet growth under equal-length exactly antiphase seasons, identical average local growth rates, and a fixed positive sum of constant directed migration rates. It does not determine nonlinear persistence or arbitrary asymmetric growth models.
title: Balanced migration maximizes growth in antiphase seasonal two-patch networks
